title: Using Letter Positional Probabilities to Assess French Word Complexity
abstract: arXiv:2610.28040v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We use Letter Positional Probabilities (LPPs) to examine the orthographic differences between simple and complex French words. We draw from a sample of 38,000 French words scored by reaction time on a lexical decision task. We take the 5000 highest reaction time words and the 5000 lowest as a proxy for high and low word complexity groups respectively. We create 18 variables based on the structure of the words, such as length and number of syllables. We also reduce each word to a string of binary values by one-hot encoding each letter according to the 42 characters of the standard French alphabet up to a length of 25 letters. Thus, each word is represented by 42 x 25 binary characters. We then create LPPs by looking at the average binary scores for simple as opposed to complex words for all letter/positions. translated_title: 利用字母位置概率评估法语单词复杂度
translated_abstract: 我们使用字母位置概率（LPP）来考察简单法语单词与复杂法语单词之间的正字法差异。我们从一个包含38,000个法语单词的样本中抽取数据，这些单词在词汇判断任务中按反应时间评分。我们选取反应时间最高的5000个单词和最低的5000个单词，分别作为高复杂度组和低复杂度组的代表。我们基于单词的结构创建了18个变量，例如单词长度和音节数量。此外，我们根据标准法语字母表的42个字符，对每个单词的字母进行独热编码，最长编码至25个字母，从而将每个单词简化为一串二进制值。因此，每个单词由42×25个二进制字符表示。随后，我们通过比较简单单词与复杂单词在所有字母/位置上的平均二进制得分来构建LPP。我们发现，有大量LPP与单词复杂度相关。例如，我们发现大多数带重音符号的字母……
tldr: 本文提出利用字母位置概率（LPP）这一新指标，通过对比词汇判断任务中反应时间最高与最低的单词组，发现大量字母/位置概率与法语单词复杂度显著相关。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Letter Positional Probabilities (LPPs) as a novel measure, finding that a large number of letter/position probabilities are significantly associated with French word complexity by comparing words with the highest and lowest reaction times on a lexical decision task.
